objects.reason: The complete caption and objects are legible in the embedded image and rendered slide 19. The numerical phrase is preserved with source context and an explicit non-normative limit; no external mirror is used as proof of provenance.

The original slide, legend, source link, dated snapshot and speaker notes explain the categories but provide no country-by-country text. Small borders and striped fills cannot be exhaustively assigned to countries with confidence. The map also cannot serve as current regulatory authority.
